explication: CodeAssist is an on-device Android/Java IDE. A developer edits a project through the Android host; the workspace engine maintains project state and language intelligence, then the build daemon plans incremental tasks, invokes Android tooling, produces and signs an APK, and installs or launches it. Preview services provide XML and Compose rendering through isolated runtimes. The tree and excerpts support these core flows; Git, block editing, and some language backends are documented but not sufficiently sampled for detailed wiring.
